prompt: A column of random numbers ranked second by impurity importance. Why?

choices.why: Gaps were filled with −1 everywhere.

choices.text: Many values give trees many lucky splits

choices.text: The noise was secretly related to churn

choices.text: Random forests always rank new columns high

prompt: How does permutation importance measure a column?

choices.text: By counting how often trees split on it
choices.why: That is closer to impurity importance.

choices.text: By refitting the model without it
choices.why: That is a different, slower method.

choices.text: By the score lost when it is shuffled on test rows
choices.why: Yes. A column the model ignores costs nothing to shuffle.

choices.text: By its correlation with the label
choices.why: That ignores the model entirely.
